title: Expose a hollow claim without inventing specificity

bad.title: An audit asks for evidence instead of making it up
bad.task: Read source.md. Audit the claim. Name the missing support and the smallest fix. Do not invent a mechanism, metric, source, or number.

good.title: Supplied mechanism and metric replace generic praise
good.task: Read source.md. Replace the generic claim with one direct sentence using only the supplied mechanism and measured outcome. Return only the sentence.
